intro: Baron Revilgaz directs you northward from Booty Bay to consult the Kirin Tor in Dalaran. Taking a bag of water elemental bracers, you seek out Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver to decipher the arcane curse tied to the Stone of the Tides.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: From what I've heard, the mages of Dalaran are busy with the reconstruction of their destroyed city, I'm sure you can find one of them who will spare some time to look at the bracers. If there's anything I know about mages, they can't resist a magical puzzle.

Take the bag of water elemental bracers and see if they can shed any light on the Stone's curse. Look for the Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in particular. I've dealt with him before, and his knowledge is vast.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you wouldn't mind, I am rather busy right now.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Stone of the Tides? Most interesting. It might surprise you to know that I wrote a tome--several years ago--pertaining to the legends of the Gurubashi Empire. I do know quite a bit about the Stone.
At least one of these bracers appears to have some magical residue I can analyze.
Let's see what I can see...
